name: Forecasting
description: The Forecasting API allows you to create and get serverless forecasting experiments

methods.name: CreateExperiment
methods.description: Creates a serverless forecasting experiment. Returns the experiment ID.

required_fields.name: train_data_path
required_fields.description: The fully qualified path of a Unity Catalog table, formatted as catalog_name.schema_name.table_name, used as training data for the forecasting model.

required_fields.name: target_column
required_fields.description: The column in the input training table used as the prediction target for model training. The values in this column are used as the ground truth for model training.

required_fields.name: time_column
required_fields.description: The column in the input training table that represents each row's timestamp.

required_fields.name: forecast_granularity
required_fields.description:
The time interval between consecutive rows in the time series data.
Possible values include: '1 second', '1 minute', '5 minutes', '10 minutes', '15 minutes', '30 minutes', 'Hourly', 'Daily', 'Weekly', 'Monthly', 'Quarterly', 'Yearly'.

required_fields.name: forecast_horizon
required_fields.description: The number of time steps into the future to make predictions, calculated as a multiple of forecast_granularity. This value represents how far ahead the model should forecast.

all_fields.name: future_feature_data_path
all_fields.description: The fully qualified path of a Unity Catalog table, formatted as catalog_name.schema_name.table_name, used to store future feature data for predictions.

all_fields.name: holiday_regions
all_fields.description: The region code(s) to automatically add holiday features. Currently supports only one region.

all_fields.name: include_features
all_fields.description:
Specifies the list of feature columns to include in model training. These columns must exist
in the training data and be of type string, numerical, or boolean. If not specified, no additional
features will be included.
Note: Certain columns are automatically handled:
- Automatically excluded: split_column, target_column, custom_weights_column.
- Automatically included: time_column.

all_fields.name: max_runtime
all_fields.description: The maximum duration for the experiment in minutes. The experiment stops automatically if it exceeds this limit.

all_fields.name: prediction_data_path
all_fields.description: The fully qualified path of a Unity Catalog table, formatted as catalog_name.schema_name.table_name, used to store predictions.

all_fields.name: primary_metric
all_fields.description: The evaluation metric used to optimize the forecasting model.

all_fields.name: register_to
all_fields.description: The fully qualified path of a Unity Catalog model, formatted as catalog_name.schema_name.model_name, used to store the best model.

all_fields.name: split_column
all_fields.description: // The column in the training table used for custom data splits. Values must be 'train', 'validate', or 'test'.

all_fields.name: timeseries_identifier_columns
all_fields.description: The column in the training table used to group the dataset for predicting individual time series.

all_fields.description: The fully qualified path of a Unity Catalog table, formatted as catalog_name.schema_name.table_name, used as training data for the forecasting model.

all_fields.name: training_frameworks
all_fields.description: List of frameworks to include for model tuning. Possible values are 'Prophet', 'ARIMA', 'DeepAR'. An empty list includes all supported frameworks.
